xsitk_connected_threshold — 2D extra op

• Data kinds: image → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "xsitk_connected_threshold", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

Connected threshold region growing (SimpleITK `ConnectedThreshold`, region growing). Uses the pixel at the image center as a seed and grows the region to include only pixels connected to the center that fall within an intensity interval centered on that pixel's value.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a は下限マージン(0.1+0.3*a)、b は上限マージン(0.1+0.3*b`)を振る —— 区間は [中心値-下限, 中心値+上限]。画像中心付近に対象があることを前提とした op。
